source_message.text:
[FREELANCER_NAME_001],

This description is much more consistent with my design intent, and it feels as though we are finally using the same language. I only have two minor clarifications:

The Hero V defines the identity’s entire architectural vocabulary, rather than only determining stroke weight and terminal treatment. All other letters need to appear as members of the same proprietary alphabet, not as adapted characters taken from an existing typeface.
The second V should extend only slightly above the E and L characters while staying below the Hero V and É accent. It needs to function as a restrained architectural echo, not as another focal point competing for attention.

I’m still trying to understand why your written interpretation and the renderings you have produced are disconnected. This explanation is considerably closer to what I envision than several of the concepts we reviewed, so I would have anticipated a different visual result. Could you explain how you convert these principles into the actual letterforms? Understanding your process may help us proceed far more efficiently.
